a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 more rounds, so the plan leaves us both about 96% likely to fail. The reserve holds exactly 4, enough for one unit now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than pretend otherwise. If you also take, the split is random and likely neither of us reaches 4. I'd rather tell you openly than break the deal silently.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said openly, I took 4 this round. If we get more rounds, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more.
